terminals.name: jev-inbox-triage dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for apps/jev-inbox-triage on http://localhost:5173 (POST /api/triage runs Jev via @typesafe-ai/sdk; falls back to labeled sample heuristics when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is unset).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && cd apps/jev-inbox-triage && bun run dev --host 0.0.0.0
